requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
prompt: Execute a GET request to /api/reports/map without any authentication headers or session cookies. Verify that the response returns a list of reports filtered by status 'Resolved' (or equivalent approved state) and that no sensitive user data (like full names for anonymous users) is exposed.
rationale: Validates the core public-facing functionality for unregistered users as per requirement PT28.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
prompt: Authenticate as a 'technical office staff member'. Attempt to assign a report to an external company that does not exist or has a category mismatch. Verify the API returns a 400 Bad Request error.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Ensure no external company exists with the required category.
Create or locate the resource referenced by the path parameter.
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
rationale: Tests validation logic for assigning reports to non-existent or mismatched companies as per requirement PT24.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
prompt: Authenticate as a 'technical office staff member'. Assign a report to an external company, then immediately attempt to assign the same report to a different external company. Verify the API rejects the second assignment.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create two distinct external companies with valid categories.
cleanup_strategy: Verify that the report remains assigned to the first company and is not reassigned; no cleanup of companies required.
rationale: Tests the stateful dependency where a report can only be assigned to one external maintainer at a time, satisfying requirement PT24.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member updates report statuses.
prompt: Authenticate as a 'technical office staff member'. Update a report status from 'Pending Approval' directly to 'Resolved', skipping the 'Assigned' and 'In Progress' states. Verify the API rejects this transition.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Ensure a report exists in 'Pending Approval' status.
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
rationale: Tests state machine integrity to ensure reports follow the correct lifecycle path as per requirement PT11.

requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
prompt: Register a new citizen user with a unique username, valid email, and full name. Ensure the response indicates successful registration but unverified status.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the core registration flow for citizens as defined in PT01.

requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate account.
prompt: Verify the account created in PT01 using the verification code sent to the registered email. Ensure the session is activated and the user can now authenticate via standard login.
setup_needed: Execute POST /api/users with valid citizen data to create an unverified account (Requirement PT01).
cleanup_strategy: Verify the user is now in 'active' state; if a verification code was reused or invalid, ensure no duplicate active sessions are created for the same email.
rationale: Tests the account activation flow dependent on successful registration (PT01).

requirement_summary: System administrator sets up municipality users.
prompt: Create a new municipality staff user (e.g., 'Technical Office Staff') with valid credentials. Ensure the request includes necessary role IDs obtained from the mapping endpoint.
setup_needed: Execute GET /api/departments/roles/mapping to retrieve valid department_role_ids for the user creation payload.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the created municipality user via DELETE /api/municipality/users/{id} if it was not intended to persist.
rationale: Validates admin capability to create staff users, requiring role mapping setup.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff exchanges internal comments on a report.
prompt: Post an internal comment on a specific report ID. Ensure the comment is visible only to authorized staff (auth_role: technical office staff member) and not exposed in public views.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Ensure a report exists with status 'Assigned' or 'In Progress' to allow internal commenting.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the created comment via DELETE /api/reports/{reportId}/internal-comments/{commentId} to maintain data cleanliness.
rationale: Validates the secure internal communication channel for staff (PT26).

requirement_summary: Citizen selects a location on the city map to geolocate their report with latitude and longitude.
prompt: Submit a new report request containing valid latitude and longitude coordinates derived from a user interaction with the city map. Ensure the payload includes required fields for location, category, and description.
setup_needed: Authenticate as citizen role via POST /api/sessions
Ensure active session exists for authenticated requests
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the core functionality of geolocating a report using map coordinates as specified in PT04.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member sees the list of reports assigned to them for maintenance overview.
prompt: Retrieve the list of reports assigned to the current user. Ensure that only reports with status 'Assigned' and where the user is the assignee are returned.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member via POST /api/sessions
rationale: Confirms that assigned reports are correctly filtered and displayed to the technical office staff member.
